text: In the finite-sample test-time setting represented by a FlagshipCertificate C, let R and Rhat be its certified population and empirical risks, b its nonnegative loss width, and M, O, G, V, P its certified nonnegative McAllester, online-to-PAC, Gaussian/Bernstein, anytime-Ville, and prefix-kernel contributions. Then R <= Rhat + b*M + O + G + V + P. The component construction requires an application-supplied risk-gap decomposition and the corresponding component gap inequalities; it does not remove these certificate obligations.
scope: Certificate-qualified deterministic scalar result; not an independently derived statistical population-risk theorem. Does not add any data distribution, sampling model, simultaneous posterior quantifier or confidence-probability assertion absent from the prose.
